notes.title: Attempts observed before disclosure
notes.statement: AWS reported attempts in MadPot dating to 17 October; whether those attempts would have succeeded on real systems was unclear.
notes.scope: AWS MadPot telemetry; not a count of production compromises.

notes.title: An earlier attribution was retracted
notes.statement: Unit 42 withdrew its 23 October attribution for an incident because initial access could not be tied to the specific PHP2Shell CVEs.
notes.scope: That incident attribution; not evidence that every PHP2Shell report was false.

notes.title: Both CVEs entered CISA KEV
notes.statement: CISA added both identifiers to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
notes.scope: Evidence of known exploitation; the catalog does not provide a global victim count.

notes.title: Early telemetry did not show mass exploitation
notes.statement: CrowdSec's report for 21-25 October described blocked attempts and no publicly confirmed compromises known to its authors at that time.
notes.scope: A dated sensor sample and public knowledge at publication; not a global absence claim.

notes.title: Another sample had limited unsuccessful attempts
notes.statement: Wiz reported limited attempts with no completed exploit chain in the attempts it captured.
notes.scope: Wiz telemetry; this does not negate observations by other organizations.

notes.title: Exploitation confirmed in a specific deployment context
notes.statement: Unit 42 confirmed exploitation against exposed PAN-OS management interfaces and independently verified the reported attacker tooling and results.
notes.scope: Exposed PAN-OS management interfaces; this is not a measurement of exploitation across all PHP installations.

notes.title: Conditional unauthenticated remote code execution
notes.statement: AWS describes an IPv4 TCP handshake memory issue that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution under specific conditions.
notes.scope: Technical capability and affected kernel conditions; the bulletin does not quantify exploitation prevalence. Publication was 30 October PDT, 31 October UTC.
